operating_notes: Review current conditions before publishing the final schedule.
Local air-quality advisories can invalidate an exposed outdoor session even when rain and temperature remain manageable.
When live forecast wording includes thunderstorms, do not keep an open-sided covered space in the published plan; use a listed indoor fallback when one is available.
When conditions shift, use an allowed lower-exposure, indoor, or earlier same-day option when one keeps the program compliant.
Check venue hours, capacity, allowed activity tags, and support needs before publishing the final schedule.
Earlier exports are planning aids from a prior checkpoint.
